# (B) renders nav-only via WebFetch; recovered via WebSearch.

## Stream A — Gemini Enterprise release notes (dated entries)

### August 7, 2026  [NEW]
- Custom MCP server data stores reach GA. Organizations can connect their own MCP server to Gemini
  Enterprise to securely access private company data. Turned OFF by default; requires administrator
  approval (org policy constraint, with a documented override path).
  docs/connectors/custom-mcp-server/set-up-custom-mcp-server
  Auth: none or OAuth 2.0. Endpoint must be HTTPS using StreamableHTTP transport.
  MCP servers can also be imported from the Agent Registry.

### August 6, 2026  [NEW]
- The description field was removed from custom MCP server data store setup. Gemini Enterprise now
  calls the server's `tools/list` endpoint automatically to discover tools, parameter schemas and
  capabilities, and routes on the explicit tool definitions.
- Gemini 3.5 Flash removal from the global region postponed. [deprecation — not reported]

### August 4, 2026  [NEW]
- Two new trace spans for data connectors: `execute_tool` and `invoke_connector`, giving end-to-end
  parent-child workflows from the assistant prompt through to the third-party API.

### August 3, 2026  [NEW]
- 17 new connectors in public preview: Attio, Cohesity, Descript, Fiscal.ai, Gamma, iManage,
  Moody's, NetDocuments, Nexla, Oracle NetSuite, Pylon, S&P Global, Sanity, Supabase, Supermetrics,
  SurveyMonkey, Wix.
- New action: Freshservice "create ticket note".

### August 1, 2026
- Pay-as-you-go edition GA. [billing model — not reported]

## Stream B — Agent Platform release notes
- Grok 4.1 family deprecated, shutdown August 20, 2026. [deprecation]
- Nano Banana preview image models retired. [deprecation]
- No net-new Agent Platform capability since the AlphaEvolve GA / Memory Profiles GA / Feedback
  service items reported 2026-08-07.

Updated: 2026-08-09 — four reportable August items on stream A, all missed by the previous scan
because neither canonical URL is in sources.json.
